newsitem.title: USA: FULL TEXT - Marvel to block bondholders.
newsitem.headline: FULL TEXT - Marvel to block bondholders.

text.p: Marvel Entertainment Group said on Friday that the bankrupt comic book and trading card company and its secured creditors will attempt to block a bid by its bondholders to replace the company's board of directors.
A full text of the press release from Marvel Entertainment Group Inc follows:
NEW YORK, March 21 /PRNewswire/ -- Marvel Entertainment Group, Inc. (NYSE: MRV) today issued the following statement:
The inflammatory statements about the condition of Marvel made today by the bondholders fronting for Carl Icahn are untrue and do not serve the best interests of the company and its stake holders.

Mr. Icahn is obviously trying to distract attention from his persistent failure to expound a detailed, feasible plan for the operation of Marvel, and from his reneging on his proposal of only two weeks ago to pay down Marvel's secured bank debt with the proceeds of a rights offering. Instead he now seeks to grab control of the company without committing a dollar.

Rather than issuing press releases, Mr. Icahn should at long last face up to his responsibilities by explaining precisely how he intends to safeguard Marvel's future. His reckless and self-serving conduct demonstrates an unmistakable intent to exploit Marvel's vulnerable condition solely to enrich himself.

The secured creditors and Marvel intend to oppose his efforts to take control of the Board and will seek the aid of the court to compel Mr. Icahn finally to present a specific plan for the company's reorganization.
